run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the CLI script to preprocess relaxed trajectory files into LMDB graph feature databases for S2EF
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to convert ASE trajectory files into pickled graph objects stored in an LMDB database
run_main_preprocess: run main to chunk trajectory files across workers and extract graph features into LMDB shards
review_atoms_to_graphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization with max_neigh=50, radius=6, and edge and fixed atom features enabled
refactor_write_images_to_lmdb: refactor write_images_to_lmdb to add atom tags, system IDs, and frame IDs to each graph data object before storing
